raw.reasoning: Never guess or disclose hidden paths; filtered mounts receive an authoritative full reconciliation in the same sync cycle while malformed empty-path file.deleted events remain fail-closed.

events.content: Pathless provider deletion now emits only a durable sync.reconcile control when no ACL-backed path can be named; mounts persist the prompt, reconcile authoritatively in-cycle, and filtered consumers receive no path. Focused/full serialized Go and package gates are green; parallel full Go and mountsync race expose inherited test-environment races.

raw.adjustments: Added durable PendingFullReconcile state and consumer path-filter exceptions

retrospective.summary: Repaired Relayfile ACL pathless provider deletion handling with sync.reconcile control events, durable prompt reconciliation, no-path fail-closed filtering, SDK/file-observer parity, and regression tests.
